title: Choosing Humility in Victory
paragraphs: Setelah memenangkan promosi yang sangat kontroversial atas seorang rekan kerja yang benar-benar ia hormati, Faisal menghadapi tantangan pelik merayakan pencapaiannya tanpa tampak menyombongkan diri atas seseorang yang ia anggap setara secara profesional.

Alih-alih secara publik menekankan kualifikasinya sendiri relatif terhadap kekurangan rekan kerjanya, Faisal secara sengaja mengakui secara pribadi kekuatan sesungguhnya dan kontribusi spesifik rekan kerjanya terhadap proyek bersama mereka.
Pendekatan ini membutuhkan penekanan impuls alami menuju pujian diri, terutama mengingat betapa kompetitif dan dibicarakan secara publik proses promosi itu sebelumnya dalam departemen mereka.

Rekan kerjanya, yang awalnya secara wajar kecewa, kemudian menyebutkan bahwa kerendahan hati Faisal yang jelas selama periode ini melestarikan hubungan kerja mereka dengan cara yang kemungkinan besar akan rusak permanen oleh kejayaan yang terlihat.

Faisal kemudian merenungkan bahwa kerendahan hati sesungguhnya dalam kemenangan membutuhkan lebih banyak disiplin daripada kerendahan hati dalam kekalahan, karena kesuksesan secara alami menggoda seseorang menuju fokus diri justru ketika kemurahan hati kepada orang lain paling penting.

Pengalaman ini membentuk bagaimana ia selanjutnya mendekati peran kepemimpinannya sendiri, secara sengaja menyoroti kontribusi tim alih-alih pencapaian pribadi setiap kali pengakuan publik tak terhindarkan muncul.
answerKey: After winning a highly contentious promotion over a colleague he genuinely respected, Faisal faced the delicate challenge of celebrating his achievement without appearing to gloat over someone he considered a genuine professional equal. Rather than publicly emphasizing his own qualifications relative to his colleague's shortcomings, Faisal made a deliberate point of privately acknowledging his colleague's genuine strengths and specific contributions to their shared projects. This approach required suppressing a natural impulse toward self-congratulation, particularly given how competitive and publicly discussed the promotion process had become within their department beforehand. His colleague, initially understandably disappointed, later mentioned that Faisal's evident humility during this period had preserved their working relationship in ways that visible triumphalism would likely have permanently damaged. Faisal later reflected that genuine humility in victory required more discipline than humility in defeat, since success naturally tempts a person toward self-focus precisely when generosity toward others matters most. This experience shaped how he subsequently approached his own leadership role, deliberately highlighting team contributions rather than personal achievement whenever public recognition inevitably arose.
